summary.zh: 压力代表学生承受的心理负担。压力升高会削弱学生能力，达到极限时可能触发失踪、退队或退出组织等事件。
summary.en: Pressure represents a student's psychological burden. High pressure weakens abilities, and extreme pressure may trigger disappearance, squad departure, or quitting the organization.

items.zh: 每名学生都有自己的压力值。
items.en: Every student has an individual pressure value.

items.zh: 顶部 HUD 的压力显示玩家阵营成员压力的平均值。
items.en: The top HUD pressure value shows the average pressure of player faction members.

items.zh: 地块压力则来自当前区域内所有学生的平均压力。
items.en: Province pressure comes from the average pressure of all students currently in that area.

items.zh: 学生拥有低、中、高三种压力抗性。
items.en: Students have low, medium, or high pressure resistance.

items.zh: 压力抗性会影响后续获得压力的幅度和每日自然恢复。
items.en: Pressure resistance affects later pressure gains and daily recovery.

items.zh: 抗性不会改变学生初始压力，只影响后续变化。
items.en: Resistance does not change initial pressure; it only affects later changes.

items.zh: 压力升高会降低学生个人能力表现。
items.en: Rising pressure reduces individual student performance.

items.zh: 能力修正会同步影响行动小队平均能力。
items.en: Ability penalties also affect action squad averages.

items.zh: 压力达到极限时，学生可能触发崩溃事件。
items.en: When pressure reaches the limit, a student may trigger a breakdown event.
